penTip: Pen (click again for fountain pen, ballpoint or shape pen)
lasso: Lasso: circle strokes to move, resize, recolour, copy or delete them
fingerDrawing: Draw with fingers (turns off by itself once a stylus is used)
explainTip: The AI explains what you circled, in the side panel
askTip: The AI reads what you wrote since its last reply and writes back
quizTip: The AI asks a question on this note; write your answer and press Quiz me again
writeFirst: Write something first; the AI answers what is new since its last reply.
noTranscript: The AI answered but could not read your handwriting as text, so search will not find this part.
brokenPage: This handwriting notebook's data could not be loaded. Nothing was changed.
selectFirst: Select a passage or click an annotation first.
